Christmas shopping is easier with a plan. This Christmas gift guide sorts our favourite gifts by who you are buying for and what you want to spend: perfume gift sets for her and for him, discovery sets for the friend whose taste you are not sure of, skincare gift sets, and stocking fillers under £25. Everything is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, and the full edit is in our Christmas gifts collection.

The short answer

If you know their perfume, buy the gift set: you usually get a travel spray or body lotion alongside the full bottle. If you do not, choose a discovery set of miniatures. For skincare lovers, a two-step skincare set feels generous without guesswork. And fill stockings with miniatures and lip care.

Perfume gift sets for her

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set: 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and 100ml body lotion; a white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Hugo Boss Alive Eau de Parfum and Body Lotion Set: 80ml eau de parfum with a 75ml matching body lotion for layering.
  • Burberry Women’s Miniature Perfume Set: four 5ml minis from the Burberry Her family, including Her London Dream.
  • Calvin Klein Women’s Miniature Fragrance Set: four 15ml bottles with Obsession, Eternity and CK One.

Torn between the two Eternity scents? Read Calvin Klein Eternity for women vs for men. See every set in gifts for her and perfume gift sets, or read our perfume gift sets guide. Our Mugler perfume guide compares Alien and Angel.

Perfume gift sets for him

  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Toilette Intense Gift Set: a 100ml bottle and two 10ml travel sprays; bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Gift Set: 100ml and 15ml eau de parfum; fresh green tea, white lotus, musk and guaiac wood.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Fragrance Set: five minis including K, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme.
  • Chopard Oud Malaki: for the man who likes warm scents, with tobacco, leather and oud.

More in gifts for him. Buying Dior Sauvage? Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum explains which to choose, and our Tom Ford perfume guide compares Black Orchid, Noir Extreme and more. For 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom, see our Paco Rabanne perfume guide.

Not sure what they wear? Choose a discovery set

Discovery sets are the safest perfume gift: several scents in small sizes, so they can find a favourite. Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set has five 5ml Dior fragrances for women and men. Hermès Miniature Gift Set holds four 7.5ml scents from the Jardins collection. Acqua di Parma Holiday Discovery Set brings Osmanthus, Yuzu and Lily of the Valley in 12ml sprays. On a smaller budget, Korloff Paris Discovery Set has three 10ml sprays, and Signature Discovery Set has ten. For what is inside each miniature set, see our mini perfume sets guide. Wondering what the labels mean? Read extrait vs eau de parfum.

Skincare gift sets

  • Highborn London Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set: Imperial Moisturiser and Night Elixir, both in 50ml jars.
  • Highborn London Revive and Defy Starter Set: 30ml Pre-Eminent Beauty Serum and 15ml Imperial Eye Gel.
  • Vilvah Milk Face Kit: Milk Mud Mask and Milk Drops serum, from one of our official partner brands.
  • anatomē The Little Gift of Good Sleep: a 10ml Somali frankincense sleep oil roller ball and a 10ml pillow spray for a calm bedtime ritual.

More boxed sets are in gift sets. Our skincare gift sets guide lists what is in every Vilvah and Deyga kit.

Stocking fillers under £25

More small gifts in our stocking fillers for her guide.

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 10ml
  • Calvin Klein Defy Parfum 10ml
  • Hermès Un Jardin sur le Toit 15ml
  • Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit
  • Deyga Soft Lip Combo
  • Vilvah Natural Lip Scrub
  • Vilvah Neem Wood Comb Set of 3

Browse all stocking fillers and gifts under £25. Giving lip care? See how to use a lip scrub and our lip balm guide.

Delivery and returns

UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off with code SAVE5 at checkout, so a couple of gifts in one order often covers both. Everything is dispatched from the UK; order early in December so gifts arrive in time, and see our shipping policy for delivery options. Unopened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, so leave the cellophane on until the big day (see our refund policy).

A mini perfume set is a box of small bottles, usually 4ml to 15ml each, from one perfume house. It lets someone try several scents before buying a full bottle, keep a favourite in their bag, or simply enjoy a little collection. Here is what is inside the miniature sets we stock, starting with Jimmy Choo and Dior.

Why choose a mini perfume set?

  • To try before buying: wear each scent for a day or two and see which one you reach for.
  • For travel and handbags: small bottles take up little room.
  • As a gift when you are not sure of their taste: several scents from a house they like is a safer bet than one full bottle.

Sizes vary from set to set, so check the millilitres as well as the number of bottles.

Jimmy Choo mini perfume set

The Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Fragrance Gift Set holds five 4.5ml eau de parfums, 22.5ml in all:

  • I Want Choo: peach and mandarin, red spider lily and jasmine, vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum: pear, mandarin and green notes, orchid, toffee and patchouli.
  • I Want Choo Forever: rose and bitter almond, cherry, jasmine and vetiver, vanilla, tonka bean, oakmoss and amber.
  • Rose Passion: frangipani and jasmine, coconut milk and orchid, vanilla and sandalwood.
  • I Want Choo Le Parfum: blackberry, pear and gardenia, jasmine, patchouli and ambrette, praline, sandalwood and moss.

If you already know you love I Want Choo Forever, it also comes as a single 4.5ml miniature. See every Jimmy Choo fragrance.

Dior mini perfume set

The Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set has five 5ml minis for women and men: J’adore Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Toilette, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette and Sauvage Eau de Toilette. It is the set to choose for someone who loves Dior but whose favourite you do not know. Not sure which Sauvage they wear? Read Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum. More from Dior.

More miniature perfume sets for her

  • Marc Jacobs Miniature Gift Set 2025: Daisy, Daisy Eau So Fresh and Daisy Wild (4ml each) and Perfect (5ml). Fresh fruity florals, plus Perfect’s rhubarb, narcissus and almond milk.
  • Chloé Miniature Perfume Set: four 5ml bottles, Chloé Eau de Parfum, Nomade Eau de Parfum and Eau de Toilette, and Rose Tangerine. Our Chloé perfume guide compares the full bottles.
  • Gucci Flora Gorgeous Miniature Set: three 5ml bottles, Gorgeous Gardenia (pear blossom, gardenia, brown sugar), Gorgeous Magnolia (dewberries, coconut, magnolia) and Gorgeous Orchid (vanilla, vanilla orchid). Our Gucci perfume guide compares the full-size Gucci scents.
  • Mon Guerlain Miniature Set: four 5ml bottles, two Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum, Mon Guerlain Florale and Bloom of Rose, all built on lavender and vanilla.
  • DKNY Delicious Miniature Set: four 7ml eau de parfums, Be Delicious, Golden Delicious, Be Extra Delicious and Be 100% Delicious.
  • Paco Rabanne Women’s Miniature Set: Lady Million, Olympéa, and Fame in two strengths.
  • Calvin Klein Women’s Miniature Set: bigger 15ml bottles, two Obsession, one Eternity and one CK One.

Mini aftershave sets for him

  • Paco Rabanne Men’s Miniature Set: four 5ml bottles, Phantom, Invictus, 1 Million and 1 Million Elixir.
  • Paco Rabanne Men’s Eau de Toilette Set: 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom in 4ml bottles, a smaller and cheaper way to try them.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set: Devotion, K Eau de Toilette, K Eau de Parfum, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. See our Dolce & Gabbana perfume guide for the whole range.

To compare 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom before you choose, see our Paco Rabanne perfume guide.

For a set anyone can wear, the Hermès Miniature Gift Set holds four 7.5ml unisex scents from the Jardins collection: Un Jardin à Cythère, Un Jardin sur le Nil, Le Jardin de Monsieur Li and Un Jardin sur la Lagune.

Single minis under £20

When one scent is enough, a single miniature makes an easy stocking filler: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 10ml, Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Toilette 10ml, Versace Eros Pour Femme 5ml, Calvin Klein Defy Parfum 10ml and Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme 5ml. Browse every travel-size mini, or see the four 10ml Mugler Colognes in our Mugler perfume guide. The Versace 5ml minis are compared in our Versace perfume guide.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Many sets mix the two; read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the labels mean.
  • Want a full bottle with extras instead? See our best perfume gift sets guide.
  • Filling a stocking? Our stocking fillers under £25 has more ideas.
  • Store minis upright, away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.

Shop perfume gift sets for her, aftershave gift sets for him and gifts under £50. Everything is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.

  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

Full-bottle sets, from the biggest box down:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set: 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion. A creamy white floral of jasmine and tuberose.

  • Bvlgari Man Wood Essence 100ml + 15ml: citrus, coriander, cypress and vetiver, a green woody scent.
  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette and two 10ml travel sprays, with bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml + 5ml: blood orange, lemon and juniper, then sage and lavender over cedarwood.

For a man who likes to switch, the Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set holds Devotion, K in two versions, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. More in aftershave gift sets for him. Hermès Miniature Set (4 x 7.5ml) holds four unisex scents from the Jardins collection. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10ml) holds Orange Mauresque, Miel d’Arabie, Jasmin Moghol and Rose Seljuke, and Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo (3 x 12ml) three bright Mediterranean scents. Not sure what EDP or EDT means on the box? Read extrait vs eau de parfum.

Calvin Klein Eternity is a name shared by two classic fragrances: Eternity for women and Eternity for men. They sit side by side on the shelf, in similar clean, simple bottles, but they smell quite different. Here is what is in each one, how the strengths compare, and how to choose, whether for yourself or as a gift.

Calvin Klein Eternity for women

Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum (30ml or 100ml) is a classic floral: fresh citrus at the start, a big bouquet of white and spring flowers in the middle, and a soft woody base.

  • Top: freesia, mandarin orange, sage and citrus.
  • Heart: lily, carnation, violet, jasmine, rose, lily of the valley, marigold and narcissus.
  • Base: sandalwood, amber, musk, heliotrope and patchouli.

It is graceful, clean and easy to wear: a good everyday scent for the office, weddings and special days alike.

Calvin Klein Eternity for men

Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette (100ml) is a fresh aromatic fragrance: citrus and lavender first, then herbs, then warm woods.

  • Top: mandarin orange, lavender, bergamot and lemon.
  • Heart: sage, juniper berries, basil, geranium, jasmine and coriander.
  • Base: sandalwood, vetiver, musk, amber and Brazilian rosewood.

It feels crisp and clean, with a warm finish, and suits daytime and work as well as evenings.

Eternity for women vs for men: the key differences

  • Character: the women's Eternity is floral, built around lily, carnation and rose. The men's is aromatic, built around lavender and herbs such as sage, juniper and basil.
  • What they share: mandarin and sage near the top, and sandalwood, amber and musk in the base. That is why they feel like a pair.
  • Strength: we stock the women's Eternity as an eau de parfum and the men's as an eau de toilette. An eau de parfum typically holds around 15–20% perfume oil and an eau de toilette around 5–15%, so the women's feels a little fuller on skin. Read what the labels mean.
  • Who can wear them: anyone. Many women enjoy the men's lavender freshness, and many men like the women's soft florals. Choose by the notes you love.

The newer Eternity scents, in miniature

Calvin Klein has added deeper versions of Eternity. Our 10ml minis are an easy way to try them:

  • Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum for men (10ml): lavender and rum, warm spices and aromatic notes, then vanilla, woods and amber. Deeper and warmer than the classic men's EDT.
  • Eternity Aromatic Essence Parfum Intense for men (10ml): juniper berry and fresh aromatic notes, lavender and a coconut accord, then cardamom, woods and amber.
  • Eternity Aromatic Essence Parfum Intense for women (10ml): lavender and fresh aromatic notes, a floral and coconut heart, then amber, woods and musk.

See all our travel-size minis.

Eternity as a gift

For her, the Calvin Klein Women's Miniature Fragrance Set holds four 15ml bottles: Eternity Eau de Parfum, CK One Eau de Toilette and two Obsession Eau de Parfum, so she can try three classic styles. For him, pair the Eternity for Men EDT with the Eternity Parfum mini for travel. More ideas in our Christmas gift guide.

If you like Eternity, try

  • Calvin Klein Defy Parfum: mandarin, pink pepper, lavender and a suede accord over vetiver, amber and woods. A modern pick for Eternity for Men fans who like lavender.
  • Calvin Klein My Euphoria Eau de Parfum (10ml): a floral gourmand mini for women who want something sweeter than Eternity's clean florals.

Another men's classic that comes in more than one strength: Dior Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum.

How to wear it

  • Spray on moisturised skin at the neck and chest; scent has more to hold on to. See how to use a body butter.
  • Two or three sprays of eau de toilette, or one or two of eau de parfum or parfum, is a good start.
  • Keep the bottle cool and out of sunlight.

Tom Ford perfume covers a wide range, from dark, velvety evening scents to bright citrus colognes. Here are the Tom Ford fragrances we stock, what is in each one, when to wear it, and a few other scents in a similar mood if you want to compare.

Signature and Private Blend

Tom Ford's perfumes fall into two main lines. The Signature collection includes Black Orchid and Noir Extreme. The Private Blend collection includes Oud Wood, Neroli Portofino and Ébène Fumé, and is usually sold in smaller bottles at a higher price. Both are made for anyone to wear: "for men" on a label is only a guide.

Tom Ford Black Orchid

Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum (100ml) is dark and rich. It opens on truffle and plum, moves into rum, ylang-ylang and black orchid, and settles on patchouli. It is an amber floral, made unisex, and best for evenings, special occasions and the colder months. The parfum is a stronger concentration than eau de parfum, so one or two sprays are plenty.

Tom Ford Noir Extreme

Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum (100ml) is warm and spicy-sweet. Cardamom, nutmeg, saffron, mandarin and neroli open it; rose, jasmine, orange blossom and kulfi, a milky, dessert-like accord, form the heart; vanilla, amber, sandalwood and woods make the base. It is made for men and suits evenings and cooler weather.

Tom Ford Neroli Portofino

Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum (50ml) is the bright one. Italian bergamot, mandarin and Sicilian lemon lead into Tunisian neroli, orange flower and lavender, over a light base of amber and rosemary. It is unisex and easy to wear in the daytime, at work and on holiday.

Ébène Fumé and Oud Wood

Tom Ford Ébène Fumé (50ml) is smoky and woody: palo santo and black pepper, then rose and leather, over ebony wood and resin. Tom Ford Oud Wood (30ml or 50ml) is smoother: oud wood, rosewood and cardamom over sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and amber. For more on oud, read our oud perfume guide.

Which Tom Ford perfume suits you?

  • Fresh and easy for daytime: Neroli Portofino.
  • Warm, spicy and sweet: Noir Extreme.
  • Dark, rich and dramatic: Black Orchid.
  • Smoky and woody: Ébène Fumé, or the softer Oud Wood.

The season helps too. Neroli Portofino suits spring and summer, while Black Orchid, Noir Extreme, Ébène Fumé and Oud Wood come into their own in autumn and winter. Many people keep one fresh and one warm scent and switch as the weather changes.

Other scents in a similar mood

These are different perfumes, not copies, but they share some of the same notes:

  • If you like Neroli Portofino's citrus: Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura (20ml), with bergamot, orange and petitgrain over jasmine, coriander, musk and cedarwood.
  • If you like Noir Extreme's spice and vanilla: Joop! Homme Le Parfum (75ml), with lavender and cinnamon, orange blossom and tonka bean, then vanilla, amber and woods.
  • If you like Black Orchid's rum and depth: Bvlgari Man in Black (100ml), with rum, spices and tobacco, leather, tuberose and iris, over guaiac wood, benzoin and tonka bean.

How to wear it

  1. Start with one or two sprays on the neck or wrists; parfums and eau de parfums are concentrated.
  2. Spray on moisturised skin so the scent has something to sit on: see our guide to layering perfume with body butter.
  3. Let it settle before you judge it. The base notes come through after the first half hour.

Good to know

  • Parfum vs eau de parfum: read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the labels mean.
  • Sizes: Black Orchid and Noir Extreme come in 100ml bottles, Neroli Portofino and Ébène Fumé in 50ml, and Oud Wood in 30ml or 50ml.
  • Gifting? Tom Ford makes a generous present; see our Christmas gift guide.
  • Store bottles away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.

Shop every Tom Ford fragrance, all perfume for men, unisex perfume and niche perfume, all 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK.
